 Gruden Brothers Very Confident In A Bears Victory
 November 7th, 2026 
 Jon Gruden typically can’t help himself when it comes to picking the winner of a game involving his beloved Buccaneers. 
 Chucky nearly always picks Tampa Bay. However, that’s not the case week.
 Speaking on The Gruden Family Football Show , Gruden emphasized he hopes the Bucs win Sunday night in Chicago, but he doesn’t see it. The Super Bowl-winning Bucs head coach says the Chicago offensive line is on par with the Bucs’ bruising bunch and he loves how both lines move bodies. Tampa Bay’s run game ranks No. 1 in the NFL in total yards; Chicago is No. 2.
 Gruden, though, like most Bucs fans, is deeply concerned about the Bucs’ passing game. He talked about how the pass game was poor before Baker Mayfield got hurt. Gruden sees Bears stud QB Caleb Williams as the major difference-maker in this game. And he is not predicting a nail-biter.
 Bears win, says Gruden, whose brother Jay agreed.
 Jay Gruden, the former QB and NFL head coach, says he believes both teams have elite blocking from receivers and are a complete rushing attackBut Jay Gruden is highly suspect of the Bucs’ win-without-throwing formula of the past two weeks.
 “That can’t last. There’s no way,” Jay Gruden said, before picking Chicago to cruise to its seventh victory this season.
